head: /fold-bloom/ecology/

ecology.persistence: FOLD does not write a player-authored relation; each resolution checks the opposite ring slot.
ecology.traversal: A matching mirror may join, then CASCADE traverses same-type cells through the current gene neighbor law.
ecology.retained_strength: Simple, legible and already integrated with Ecology breeding, memory, Garden and gene topology.

fold_weave.persistence: foldAnchors stores a crease endpoint per symbol family; CREASE_SET and CREASE_BREAK expose changes; RETURN preserves anchors.
fold_weave.traversal: predictWeave adds the valid authored anchor as an explicit fold edge, then CASCADE starts from all reached nodes. Earlier play therefore changes future reachable topology.
fold_weave.retained_strength: Player-authored graph memory with predictive edges, visible crease echoes, and explicit failure when an anchor becomes invalid.

decision.do_not_promote: Do not merge the donor wholesale and do not replace stable MIRROR as default yet.
minimal_transfer: forecast/crease echo needed for causal legibility
decision.rationale: Persistent crease topology is a genuinely missing capability: player-authored topology. It changes the causal law rather than merely adding presentation.

promotion_gate: Expose MIRROR and CREASE as explicit alternatives in a lab/experimental mode. Make CREASE default only after direct comparative play shows improved agency/replay without material loss of flow, legibility or ecology.
